text: bare nosed wombat, adult male, came in from a carer in kongwak. 22.5 kilos, body condition 2 out of 5. severe sarcoptic mange, crusting over the flanks rump and face, fissures behind both ears, eyes partly crusted. alert but flat. temp 34.1. treated with side ectin pour on 0.5 percent at 1 mil per 10 kg along the spine, so about 2.2 mils, repeat weekly for 12 weeks. sub q fluids 400 mils hartmanns. ivermectin not given. plan back to carer, burrow flap treatment once eating, weigh weekly, recheck in 2 weeks

eastern grey roo joey, female, 1.24 kilos, early fur just coming through on the back, mum hit by car on the bass highway near grantville last night. mildly dehydrated maybe 5 percent, skin tent slow. no fractures on palpation, small graze on the tail base, cleaned with chlorhex. gave 30 mils sub q hartmanns. meloxicam 0.1 mg per kg orally once daily for 3 days. start wombaroo 0.4 roo milk, needs a pouch and heat, carer to call me if the tail graze goes red or it stops feeding

black flying fox adult female caught on barbed wire fence at a property in logan village, brought in by bat rescue. vaccinated handlers only. 640 grams. 4 cm tear through the left plagiopatagium, clean edges, no bone involvement. dehydrated, 10 mils sub q saline. under iso, cleaned and left to heal by second intention, no sutures. meloxicam 0.2 mg per kg sc today then 0.1 mg per kg orally once a day for 5 days. amoxyclav 12.5 mg per kg orally twice daily 7 days. not lactating, no pup seen. recheck wing in 7 days, flight cage when healed

koala f adult 6.8kg ex redland bay. bilat conjunctivitis, purulent dc OU, wet bottom ++, chlam pcr pos ocular + UG. BCS 3/5. US: bladder ok, no cysts on ovaries seen. tx chloramphenicol oint OU tid, doxycyline 5mg/kg sc sid 4 wks. euc browse leaf weighed daily. reck 1 wk, repeat pcr end of tx

australian magpie adult, found on the road in inverloch by a member of the public. hindlimbs paralysed, no deep pain response either leg, cloaca flaccid, wings ok. suspect spinal fracture after car strike. poor prognosis for release. euthanased under isoflurane with pentobarbitone 1 mil intracardiac. body to freezer for disposal, finder told by phone

three common ringtail possum joeys from the same nest, cat brought them in at a house in wonthaggi. joey 1 male 62 grams, two puncture wounds on the right flank, started amoxyclav 12.5 mg per kg orally twice a day 7 days and flushed with saline. joey 2 female 58 grams no wounds found. joey 3 female 55 grams no wounds, slightly cold, warmed. all eyes still closed, all on wombaroo possum milk 0.6, recheck all three in 3 days. cat contact so all need watching for infection

short beaked echidna adult, hit by car near tarwin lower. small fracture at the tip of the beak, about 5 mm, tongue moves normally, no other injuries found. 3.4 kg. meloxicam 0.2 mg per kg sc today then 0.1 mg per kg orally once daily for 5 days. offer echidna mix, soft only, carer to weigh daily and call me if not eating for 2 days. release where found once the beak has healed and it is eating normally, about 3 weeks
change: carer says it is now eating the mix on its own, and it is going to be 36 degrees tomorrow so it needs to stay cool

text: we have had 14 flying foxes come in this month badly tangled in loose fruit tree netting in backyards around logan and redland bay, 5 had to be euthanased. people should only use wildlife friendly netting where you cant fit a finger through the holes, or take netting off once the fruit is picked. never try to untangle a bat yourself, call a rescue group. quote from me, dr sam patel, vet

horse, bay gelding about 15 years, seized by an inspector from a paddock in leongatha on 12 october 2026. I examined it on 13 october 2026 at the shelter. Henneke body condition score 1 out of 9, all ribs and hip bones prominent. hooves overgrown, about 4 cm past normal length on all four with cracks. heavy lice burden and rain scald over the back. weight tape 360 kg, should be about 480 kg for its size. teeth have sharp hooks, no dental care for years I think. no feed or water in the paddock at seizure according to the inspector. in my opinion it has been underfed for at least 2 to 3 months. the owner is clearly guilty of cruelty and should be banned from owning animals

staffy x f 3y 21.4kg spey today. premed acp 0.03mg/kg + methadone 0.3mg/kg im, induced alfaxan to effect, intubated, iso maint. midline, uneventful, intradermal closure. meloxicam 0.1 mg/kg sc. recovery good. dc tmrw am. revisit 10d, cone, rest 14d, meloxicam 0.05 po sid 3d
